dedupe_keys.name: eurostat prodcom statistics on the production of manufactured goods

description: Prodcom, from the French production communautaire, gives statistics on the production of manufactured goods by enterprises in EU countries, as part of European business statistics. It covers mining and quarrying, manufacturing and materials recovery (NACE sections B, C and E), and reports the physical volume and value of production sold per product, so that production can be compared across countries and over time. National statistical institutes collect the data from enterprises; EU countries, Norway and Iceland must run the survey under the European business statistics regulation, and most candidate countries also supply data. The survey is annual, although countries may run it monthly or quarterly. Data are free in the Eurostat database and on the Prodcom pages; Eurostat's copyright notice licenses them under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: confidential values are suppressed, product codes change between years, and only enterprises above national thresholds are surveyed. For simulation it provides national production of specific manufactured products for supply-chain, capacity and dependency analyses of European industry. Related catalogue records include the FIGARO input-output tables and the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
